versos.texto_bv: e disse: Se vocês ouvirem atentamente a voz do SENHOR, seu Deus, e fizerem o que é reto diante dos seus olhos, e inclinarem os ouvidos aos seus mandamentos, e guardarem todos os seus estatutos, nenhuma das enfermidades que pus sobre o Egito porei sobre vocês; porque eu sou o SENHOR que os sara.
versos.traducao_literal: e disse: Se ouvir ouvires à voz de YHWH, teu Deus, e o reto aos seus olhos fizeres, e deres ouvido aos seus mandamentos, e guardares todos os seus estatutos, toda a enfermidade que pus no Egito não porei sobre ti, porque eu YHWH, o que te sara.
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0019): O hebraico dirige-se a Israel no singular do começo ao fim, mas a BV verte no plural “vocês/seus/os”; a norma pinada exige preservar sempre a distinção singular/plural do original. Restaurar o singular exigiria repronominalizar o verso inteiro, mudando a representação do destinatário — correção impossível sem tocar o sentido, logo o texto não muda nesta etapa. — evidência: Morfologia pinada toda em 2ms: תִּשְׁמַע (HVqi2ms), תַּעֲשֶׂה (HVqi2ms), וְהַאֲזַנְתָּ (HC/Vhq2ms), וְשָׁמַרְתָּ (HC/Vqq2ms), עָלֶיךָ (HR/Sp2ms), רֹפְאֶךָ (HVqrmsc/Sp2ms); KJV no singular (“thou… thee”). Efeito colateral no português: “diante dos seus olhos” (dele, do SENHOR) convive com “seu Deus / seus mandamentos / seus estatutos” (ora dele, ora de vocês), embaralhando os referentes do possessivo “seu” — ambiguidade que o tratamento singular desfaria.

kjv.texto: And said, If thou wilt diligently hearken to the voice of the Lord thy God, and wilt do that which is right in his sight, and wilt give ear to his commandments, and keep all his statutes, I will put none of these diseases upon thee, which I have brought upon the Egyptians: for I am the Lord that healeth thee.

vizinhos.25: And he cried unto the Lord; and the Lord shewed him a tree, which when he had cast into the waters, the waters were made sweet: there he made for them a statute and an ordinance, and there he proved them,
vizinhos.27: And they came to Elim, where were twelve wells of water, and threescore and ten palm trees: and they encamped there by the waters.

web.texto: and he said, “If you will diligently listen to Yahweh your God’s voice, and will do that which is right in his eyes, and will pay attention to his commandments, and keep all his statutes, I will put none of the diseases on you, which I have put on the Egyptians; for I am Yahweh who heals you.”

vizinhos.25: Then he cried to Yahweh. Yahweh showed him a tree, and he threw it into the waters, and the waters were made sweet. There he made a statute and an ordinance for them, and there he tested them;
vizinhos.27: They came to Elim, where there were twelve springs of water, and seventy palm trees: and they encamped there by the waters.
